headline: UNHCR Report Highlights Sharp Decline in Afghan Returnees Amid Regional Instability
lead_summary: The UN High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) has released comprehensive survey data detailing the shifting patterns of human movement across Afghanistan’s borders throughout 2022. The findings reveal a significant humanitarian crisis, characterized by a sharp decline in voluntary returns and a persistent, non-return advisory issued by the agency to protect vulnerable populations from forced displacement.
